name: Learning tracker webapp for Google Sheets

mentions.name: Learning tracker webapp for Google Sheets
mentions.description: This webapp reads a public Google Sheet used to track learning and schedule repetitions (columns for links, titles, dates, and wait times plus a formula). It pulls the sheet as CSV, renders color-coded lists and charts, and shows what's due this week on a 15-week timeline. It intentionally avoids auth, storage, and update management, and can only be shared via its source code.
mentions.problem: Google Sheets is poor to use on the phone, making it hard to review the learning schedule on mobile.
mentions.audience: Personal-use companion for the author's own learning schedule stored in Google Sheets.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I built a dumb frontend reading off of my (public) google sheet which just has 4 columns for links, title, dates and wait times, plus a formula. Webapp pulls the sheet as csv, renders as color coded lists and a couple charts. Chart shows what's due this week on a 15 week timeline.
